name: Kashmir
description: The crown of India, known for its cold climate, saffron, and rich Wazwan tradition.

visuals.landscape: Snow-capped peaks, serene lakes, and intricate wooden architecture.
visuals.kitchen: Copper utensils, firewood heating, and community hearths.

name: Punjab
description: The breadbasket of India, famous for its robust agricultural spirit and clay oven cooking.

visuals.landscape: Golden wheat fields, lively community kitchens, and sturdy brick architecture.
visuals.kitchen: Tandoors, heavy brass vessels, and open-air cooking.

name: Bengal
description: A land of rivers and fertile plains, celebrating subtle spices and freshwater fish.

visuals.landscape: Lush delta wetlands, colonial townhouses, and terracotta temples.
visuals.kitchen: Clay stoves, hand-ground mustard, and banana-leaf serving.

name: Kerala
description: The spice coast, where coconut, black pepper, and sea trade define the palate.

visuals.landscape: Palm-fringed backwaters, traditional houseboats, and white-sand beaches.
visuals.kitchen: Coconut shell ladles, spice drying yards, and steam-based cooking.

name: Rajasthan
description: The desert kingdom of royals, utilizing dried ingredients and clarified butter.

visuals.landscape: Sand dunes, massive sandstone forts, and colorful traditional attire.
visuals.kitchen: Low-water cooking, stone grinders, and rich ghee storage.

name: Delhi
description: The political and culinary heart, a melting pot of royal courts and street culture.

visuals.landscape: Grand monuments, chaotic narrow alleys, and sprawling modern avenues.
visuals.kitchen: Imperial ovens, street-side woks, and complex spice grinding.
